title: Masturbation
summary: Masturbation means touching your own body, usually the genitals, for sexual pleasure. It is very common, normal and healthy at any age and whether or not you're in a relationship.
key_points: It doesn't cause weakness, blindness, infertility or hair loss — those are myths.
It can relieve stress, help sleep and help people learn what they enjoy.
It becomes a concern only if it causes distress or crowds out daily life.
Clean hands and toys; use lube if there's friction.
answer_guidance: Answer without shame and debunk myths if they come up. If asked 'how', keep it educational and non-graphic.
